arm_A: Original LiuQP objective with zero added task gradient; no terminal IK/posture/escape memory; common verified numerical profile and certified block executor
arm_B: Previously accepted configuration-recurrence and winding method with identical certified block executor
representation: ellipsoid, shared identical frozen historical pre-motion snapshot per pair
input_rule: last causal publication before the first changed robot history state; if no robot movement, last causal publication in the original run; no path or success outcome used for selection
compute_budget_includes: candidate static endpoint initialization, runtime import/setup, solve, execution and record finalization; input-dataset preparation and independent audits separately reported
initialization: same 384 candidate static search and up to 12 fixed refinements, then accepted rank-aware port initializer; no outcome-dependent retries
goal: error strictly below 1mm for 50 physical cycles
pair_order: alternate A-first/B-first by original matrix index; same four CPU cores for both arms; fresh process per run
preflight: seed1 of each of 15 tasks; input/model/recording and short-prefix interface checks, not a success-rate screening gate
ordinary_failure: keep all initialization/no-arrival/timeout results; baseline runs even if candidate init fails; no parameter changes or replacement results after freeze
scope: historical development regression, not unseen-world or new online-sensing validation
notes: Ordinary initialization, no-arrival, solver, safety, and budget failures remain in the 300-pair denominator. No tuning or replacement formal runs.
